author: Yffe
content:
Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_scheme_certs.rs::divergence_list_fold_three_distinct_item_certs (#[ignore]d, run with --ignored).

ROOT CAUSE: check::item_subprogram for Item::SpecFn returns Program{ adt_deps + ALL spec_items } — identical for every spec fn in the file (the checked item is not distinguished; it merely rides along in spec_items). Confirmed: the three spec-fn sub-programs of conformance/list_fold.th lower to BYTE-IDENTICAL Verus (same DefaultHasher 38213b645c7b112, len 1420). The proof-cache content-address (cache::cache_key over the lowered source) therefore collides, and the stored len_list certificate (carrying f.name=len_list) is served for sum_list and all_positive. forge check --json emits items [List, len_list, len_list, len_list].

AUTHORITY: conformance/adt-schemes/cases.json certify block requires three DISTINCT L3 items: len_list, sum_list, all_positive. thermite-design.md §6 (the certificate lists EVERY function's level) + §5.3 (per-item isolated sub-program). A cert whose item field is a neighbor's name violates the §6 per-function manifest contract.

NOTE: not a proof-soundness bug — all three are genuinely L3 (the served cert is a real L3); it is a certificate-IDENTITY divergence. A fix should make the per-spec-fn sub-program (or cache key) item-distinguishing so each spec fn certifies under its own name. The crux (fold_bound multiplier, faithful catamorphism, flat-step cage, dec-nuance) is GENUINE — see report.
